Message.Name: Enter Order Message
Message.Description: The Enter Order message is used to enter a new order into the market. The response to a successful Enter Order message is an Order Accepted message. If the order is rejected, the Order Rejected message will be returned.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: Client-generated order identifier

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order book identifier (i.e. the instrument identifier).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being entered.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Order quantity

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order (signed integer)

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: The time validity of the order.

Field.Name: Open Close
Field.Description: Not used by ASX. Set to zero.

Field.Name: Client/Account
Field.Description: Client – a free text field typically used by the customer to indicate the ultimate client making the order.

Field.Name: Customer Info
Field.Description: Customer information – a free text field typically used by the customer to indicate the own order identifier.

Field.Name: Exchange Info
Field.Description: A free text field used at the customer’s discretion.

Field.Name: Clearing Participant
Field.Description: Clearing participant identifier.

Field.Name: Crossing Key
Field.Description: Crossing key for Unintentional Crossing Prevention. When two orders from the same customer with the same crossing key trade out, the resulting trade is treated like a booked transaction and not published to the market as a trade. 0 (zero) means no Unintentional Crossing Prevention for this order.

Field.Name: Regulatory Data
Field.Description: data

Field.Name: OUCH Order Type
Field.Description: OUCH order type

Field.Name: Short Sell Quantity
Field.Description: For short sell orders, the portion of the quantity that is short.

Field.Name: Minimum Acceptable Quantity
Field.Description: MAQ of Centre Point Block order, Any Price Block order or Limit Sweep order when executing in Centre Point. Specifies the minimum quantity that must be traded in each execution cycle.

Message.Name: Replace Order Message
Message.Description: The Replace Order message is used to amend an existing order that was entered with ASX Trade OUCH. The response to a successful Replace Order message is an Order Replaced message. If the amendment is rejected, the Order Rejected message will be returned.

Field.Name: Existing Order Token
Field.Description: The original order token used when the order was entered, not from any prior amendments.

Field.Name: Replacement Order Token
Field.Description: The original order token used when the order was entered, or the replacement order token from any prior amendments.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Desired total quantity of the order (open quantity plus any executed quantity).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order (signed integer).

Field.Name: Open Close
Field.Description: Not used by ASX. Set to zero.

Field.Name: Client/Account
Field.Description: Client – a free text field typically used by the customer to indicate the ultimate client making the order.

Field.Name: Customer Info
Field.Description: Customer information – a free text field typically used by the customer to indicate the own order identifier.

Field.Name: Exchange Info
Field.Description: A free text field used at the customer’s discretion.

Field.Name: Regulatory Data
Field.Description: Ignore, not currently used.

Field.Name: Short Sell Quantity
Field.Description: For short sell orders, the portion of the quantity that is short.

Field.Name: Minimum Acceptable Quantity
Field.Description: MAQ of Centre Point Block order, Any Price Block order or Limit Sweep order when executing in Centre Point. Specifies the minimum quantity that must be traded in each execution cycle. 0 = no change to MAQ.

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: The Cancel Order message is used to cancel an existing order that was entered with ASX Trade OUCH, using the order token to identify the order being cancelled. The response to a successful Cancel Order message is an Order Cancelled message. If the cancellation is rejected, the Order Rejected message will be returned.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The original order token used when the order was entered, not the replacement token from a subsequent amendment.

Message.Name: Cancel By Order ID Message
Message.Description: The Cancel By Order ID message is used to cancel an existing own customer order that was entered with ASX Trade OUCH or another protocol (for example the OMNet API), using the order ID to identify the order being cancelled. The response to a successful Cancel By Order ID message is an Order Cancelled message. If the cancellation is rejected, the Order Rejected message will be returned.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order book identifier (i.e. the instrument identifier)

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being cancelled.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The order identifier assigned to the order by ASX Trade.

Message.Name: Order Accepted Message
Message.Description: The Order Accepted message acknowledges the receipt and acceptance of a valid Enter Order message. The data fields from the Enter Order message are echoed back in the Order Accepted message, but some of the accepted values may differ from the entered values for some fields, depending on the state of the order. If the order for example traded immediately at entry, the Order Accepted message will show the state of the order after the trade.

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).

Field.Name: Crossing Key
Field.Description: Crossing key for Unintentional Crossing Prevention. When two orders from the same customer with the same crossing key trade out, the resulting trade is treated like a booked transaction and not published to the market as a trade. Zero means “no Unintentional Crossing Prevention” for this order.

Field.Description: MAQ of Centre Point Block order, Any Price Block order or Limit Sweep order when executing in Centre Point. Specifies the minimum quantity that must be traded in each execution cycle. 0 = no MAQ.

Message.Description: This message is returned when an Enter Order, Replace Order, Cancel Order or Cancel By Order ID message is rejected

Message.Name: Order Cancelled Message
Message.Description: The Order Cancelled message informs the ASX Trade OUCH user that an order has been cancelled. This could be to acknowledge a Cancel Order or Cancel By Order Id message, or it could be as a result of system cancellation of an order.

Field.Description: UNIX time (number of nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).

Field.Description: Client-generated order identifier.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the order by ASX Trade. Note that this number is only unique per order book and side.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: The reason for the cancellation.
